newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine Peronists seek to expand mortgage bank.
newsitem.headline: Argentine Peronists seek to expand mortgage bank.

text.p: Congressmen from Argentina's governing Peronist Party want to expand the lending capacity of the state-owned mortgage bank with a bond issue, said Peronist Chamber of Deputies head Jorge Matzkin.
"The idea of capitalizing the bank is to create jobs with loans to construct 50,000 homes before the end of the year," Matzkin told the state-run Telam news agency late Tuesday.

The congressmen's proposal for the Banco Hipotecario to issue bonds for $500 million would in practice put back the government's plans to privatize the bank until at least 1998, local newspapers reported Wednesday.
Capitalizing the Bank Hipotecario with a bond issue would boost loans enough to create 200,000 jobs, Matzkin said.

In a separate development, Under Secretary for Banks Francisco Susmel announced that the Banco Hipotecario will soon launch a range of home loans financing up to 95 percent of the cost of construction, local papers reported.
